metadata.description: Choose independent accessibility knowledge, evidence and workflow plugins for Copilot CLI

plugins.name: a11y-bug-bash
plugins.description: Feature-scoped accessibility bug bash: context-driven page checks, reused read-only knowledge review, and evidence-separated findings. Uses existing authorized host tools.

plugins.name: a11y-setup
plugins.description: Check and prepare selected Windows accessibility dependencies using the shared host installer; keep consent, restart and live readiness explicit.

plugins.name: a11y-knowledge
plugins.description: Read-only accessibility knowledge for any project, including built-in SPDS, Fluent V8/V9 and SharePoint/ODSP guidance selected only when relevant. One installation; no execution setup.

plugins.name: a11y-knowledge-odsp
plugins.description: Compatibility installation for existing ODSP knowledge users. New users install a11y-knowledge, which includes this read-only submodule and all references.

plugins.name: a11y-intake
plugins.description: Claim-aware work-item intake, acceptance and canonical scenario preparation.

plugins.name: a11y-resources
plugins.description: Shared DevBox/Codespace ownership, health and scoped resource operations.

plugins.name: a11y-capture
plugins.description: Real Windows assistive-technology BEFORE/AFTER evidence under exclusive ownership.

plugins.name: a11y-validate
plugins.description: Deterministic integrity gates plus independent accessibility evaluation.

plugins.name: a11y-publish
plugins.description: Reviewer-safe Draft PR evidence and live publication validation.

plugins.name: agent-operations
plugins.description: Durable task continuation, cleanup, progress assessment and Run Insights.

plugins.name: a11y-workflow
plugins.description: Optional complete evidence-first composition of shared capabilities with caller-selected source and review tools.
